allowedWork: Reconcile project memory, finish the solve-x branch-scheduling and responsive-attention exemplar, prove structured algebra, pressure-test fraction composition, add governed semantic and LLM authoring, and promote the approved bounded breadth exemplars in dependency order.

Extract only contracts proven by exemplars, preserve accepted semantic documents and measured-motion ownership, use shared routes and verification, and commit each reversible slice with durable evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not generalize a subjective visual pattern before its human exemplar approval, bypass dependency order, or overwrite unrelated user-authored roadmap and design work.

Do not add LLM-authored DOM, CSS, pixels, arbitrary keyframes, unchecked math, course-scale curriculum, dynamic package loading, parked FTC/BFS/economics/programming/physics work, or broad WebGL generalization.
goal: Execute the approved dependency-ordered product frontier from branch scheduling and responsive attention through structured algebra, fraction composition, governed semantic and LLM authoring, and bounded exemplar breadth.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with its Theseus evidence; never mix user-authored unrelated document edits into a slice commit.
stopConditions: H1 HUMAN-EXEMPLAR: stop at every required visual or interaction exemplar checkpoint until the user reviews generated evidence.
H2 SCOPE: stop if work would exceed the five approved goals, revive a deferred area, or generalize beyond exemplar evidence.
H3 DEPENDENCY: stop if a later goal would begin before its required predecessor is verified and resolved.
H4 PRESERVATION: stop if accepted semantic documents, measured-motion ownership, reader routing, URL state, accessibility, or approved visual parity cannot be preserved.
H5 VERIFICATION: stop if a required focused, boundary, release, or Theseus validation gate fails without a bounded in-scope repair.
H6 USER-OVERLAP: stop if a required edit cannot be separated from unrelated user-authored worktree changes.
H7 AUTHORITY: stop if required external mutation or destructive work exceeds the user's approval.
